data.action: 卡座捧珍珠奶茶，星瞳盯着蛋糕草莓，手套轻碰碟沿
data.camera: medium two-shot, cafe booth, bright interior, playful mood
data.description: 【学园都市奶茶店·午后】女王蜂窝在窗边卡座里，金色的长发铺满半个椅背，手里捧着大杯珍珠奶茶。她用吸管有一下没一下地搅着，星瞳在看到你蛋糕上的草莓时忽然亮起来——「本小姐才不是想要……只是帮你分担热量而已哦♪」雪白的手套指节轻轻碰了碰你的碟子边缘，像一场不动声色的加冕。
data.lighting: 明亮的店内暖光与窗边日光
data.location: 学园都市奶茶店窗边卡座
data.promptProse: Shokuhou Misaki relaxes in the tea-shop window booth, stirring milk tea while her other gloved knuckle taps the companion's cake plate opposite her. Star-pupiled eyes follow its strawberry, long blonde hair spread along the seat above her beige vest and grey skirt. The medium two-shot keeps the clothed companion and shared table distinct. Warm interior light softens her teasing smile, while window daylight brightens the drink and cake, casting straw shadows across the plate.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 奶茶店的午后加冕·「这块蛋糕，分你一口好了」
